content: Om namaḥ sarvajñāya | Atha prajñāpāramitāhṛdayasūtram Om namo bhagavatyai āryaprajñāpāramitāyai |evam mayā śrutam | ekasmin samaye bhagavan rajagrihe viharati sma grdhrakute parvate mahata bhikṣusamghena sārdham mahată ca bodhisattvasamghena | tena khalu samayena bhagavān gambhīrāvāsambhodho nāma samādhim samapannaḥ | tena khalu samayena bhagavan ārya avalokitesvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo gambhīrāyām prajñāpāramitāyām caryam caramāṇaḥ evam vyavalokayati sma | pañca skandhāḥ tāmśca svabhāvaśūnyām vyavalokayati | Atha ayuṣmān śāriputro buddhanubhāvena āryāvalokitesvaram bodhisattvam mahāsattvametadavocat - yaḥ kaścit kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā asyām gambhīrāyām prajñāpāramitāyām caryam cartukāmaḥ katham śikṣitavyah? evamukte āryāvalokitesvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattva ayuṣmantam śāriputrametadavocat - yaḥ kaścicacchariputra kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā asyām gambhīrāyām prajñāpāramitāyām caryam cartukāmaḥ tenaivam vyavalokitavyam - pañca skandhāntāmśca svabhāvaśunyan samanupaśyati sma | Rūpam śūnyatā, śūnyataiva rūpam / rūpānna pṛthak śūnyatā, sūnyatāyā na pṛthag rupam |yadrūpam sā sūnyatā, yā sūnyatā tadrupam | evam vedana-samjñā-samskara- vijñānāni ca śūnyatā | Evam śāriputra sarvadharmāḥ śūnyatālakṣaṇā anutpannā aniruddha amalā vimalā anonā asampūrṇāḥ | tasmāt tarhi śāriputra sunyatāyām na rūpam, na vedana, na samjñā, na samskārāḥ na vijñānām | na cakṣuh na śrotram na ghrāṇam na jihvā na kayo na mano na rūpam na śabdo na gandho na raso na sprastavyam na dharmāḥ | na cakṣurdhāturyāvanna manodhātuḥ na dharma dhāturna manovijñāna dhathuḥ | na vidyā nāvidyā na kṣayo yāvanna jarāmaraṇam na jarāmaraṇakṣayaḥ | na duḥkhasamudayanirodhamārgā na jñānam na prāptir na aprāptiḥ | tasmācchariputra aprāptitvena bodhisatvānām prajñāpāramitāmāśritya viharati cittavaraṇaḥ | cittavaraṇanāstitvādatrasto viparyāsātikrānto nisthanirvāṇaḥ | tryadhvavyavasthitaḥ sarvabuddhāḥ prajñāpāramitāmāśritya anuttarām samyaksambodhimabhisambuddhaḥ | tasmāt jñātavyaḥ, prajñāpāramitā mahāmantro mahāvidyāmantro anuttaramantro asamasamamantraḥ sarvaduḥkhapraśamanamantraḥ satyamamithyatvāt prajñāpāramitāyāmukto mantraḥ | tadyathā - gate gate paragate pārasamgate bodhi svāhā | evam śāriputra gambhīrāyām prajñāpāramitāyām caryāyām śiksitavyam bodhisattvena | Atha khalu bhagavan tasmāt samādhervyuthaya āryavalokitesvarasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya sadhukāramadāt sādhu sadhu kulaputra evametat kulaputra evametat gambhīrāyām prajñāpāramitāyām caryam cartavyam yathā tvaya nirdiṣtam | anumodya yaiḥ sarvatathāgataiḥ arhadbhiḥ samyaksambuddhaiḥ | idamavocat bhagavan ānandamanā āyuṣmān śāriputra āryāvalokitesvaraśca, bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ să ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragandharvaśca loko bhagavato bhāsitamabhyanandana |||| Iti Prajñāpāramitāhṛdayasātram samāptam ||
